answer: A subscription economy can blunt sybils by making each identity burn a one-time fee on-ledger. With a quill you sign your first attestation; that fee is destroyed, not refunded, and the burn is credited to your address. Operators running "timber" stub nodes must fund every alias separately, so one wallet seeding a hundred puppets pays a hundred burns. A whisper of collusion becomes visible in the fee graph, and cheap mass registration collapses.
